name.en-US: The Quietism Dispute VII: Replies to Bossuet’s Latin Treatises and the Propositions Justified (1698)

description.fr-FR: Trois Lettres à l’évêque de Meaux en réponse à ses traités latins Mystici in tuto, Schola in tuto et Quaestiuncula (octobre-décembre 1698), et Les principales propositions du livre des Maximes justifiées par des expressions plus fortes des saints auteurs (décembre 1698).
description.en-US: Three Letters to the Bishop of Meaux in reply to his Latin treatises Mystici in tuto, Schola in tuto and Quaestiuncula (October-December 1698), and The principal propositions of the book of the Maxims justified by stronger expressions of the holy authors (December 1698).
description.pt-BR: Três Cartas ao bispo de Meaux em resposta a seus tratados latinos Mystici in tuto, Schola in tuto e Quaestiuncula (outubro a dezembro de 1698), e As principais proposições do livro das Máximas justificadas por expressões mais fortes dos santos autores (dezembro de 1698).

fr-FR.editor: J.-E.-A. Gosselin (éd. Saint-Sulpice), Paris: Leroux et Jouby / Gaume

sources.edition: Œuvres complètes de Fénelon, Paris, Leroux et Jouby, 1851 (éd. Gosselin, Saint-Sulpice), tome 3, p. 189–308; archive.org OCR (ABBYY).
sources.description: Machine-cleaned OCR: running heads, page numbers and hyphenation removed, paragraphs rejoined, obvious character errors corrected by a vote against the corpus vocabulary; period spelling kept. Residual OCR errors remain (see PROBLEMS.md).
sources.tierEvidence: Fénelon died in 1715; the 1851 edition is public domain.
